wiki.body:
German / Western at 368 Huanshi Dong Lu,Yue Xiu District,Guangzhou LN Garden hotel,2F Mezzanine Level. Published Restaurant Week Winners set menus list Red Snapper | Plum | Caviar, Canton Style Sausage | Chenpi | Rose wine, Burrata. Advance reservation and published menu conditions apply.

The named choices, set prices, service fees, minimum party size and supplements below are published for this specific branch.

Restaurant Week Winners 2026 — Elite Dinner

Published branch-specific event set menu, 10 October–8 November 2026. ¥588p.p.; Set menu for 1; Min. 1 guest; * All the prices already include service charges; Restaurant Week Dinner Exclusive Privilege: During the event, Restaurant Week guests will enjoy the special Restaurant Week menu. This seating is a limited collaboration with DiningCity. Reservations are on a first-come, first-served basis. Valid only for bookings made via the platform at least one day in advance. Platform pricing does not apply to walk-in guests. 1. Cannot be used in conjunction with other promotions or discounts. 2. Valid for dine-in only; private rooms are not available. Pre-meal takeout is not provided, but leftovers can be packed for free. 3. Menu items are non-exchangeable. In the event of seasonal unavailability or other unforeseen factors, the restaurant will substitute items with those of equivalent value. Specific matters shall be negotiated with the restaurant. Restaurant Week Dinner Menu. Course choices and supplements are retained; regular dishes are not assigned to this offer.
